pos.personaBrief: Sources describe an obedient, compact side with counter-attacks (Lancepedia 2007) and best defence, with no possession play documented; Trivela notes a changed way of playing with Adriano.

pro.personaBrief: Counter-attacking, pragmatic side with Ceni and a trio of centre-backs; strong marking midfielders (Hernanes, Richarlyson) favour safe, direct progression over elaborate build-up.

est.personaBrief: Obedient team that knows its functions (NSC 2006, JB 2008), with a fixed 3-5-2 or 4-4-2 and players aware of tactical duties; not a rondo-style relational side.

lar.personaBrief: 3-5-2 with three centre-backs and a crowded centre; Trivela 2008 notes lack of full-backs; wide play was not the identity.

blo.personaBrief: Compact, strong midfield marking and record-low goals conceded (19 in 2007), counter-attacking; strikers helped mark, but no high-press structure is described.

mar.personaBrief: Individual marking in May 2006 with only a considered switch to zonal against aerial balls; video analysis of individual opponents (JB 2008) suggests man-oriented tendencies.

pla.personaBrief: Muricy studies each opponent in detail by video (JB 2008, NSC 2006 'radiografia do Chivas') and imposes obedience; he changes tactical alternations per game (Trivela 2007).

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic title-winner, safe and mentally strong team (Trivela 2007), a warrior side; results over show.

sis.personaBrief: Cheap free signings turned into three-time champions through discipline and tactics; obedient team, with functions clear for all (JB 2008, NSC 2006).

jog.personaBrief: Muricy himself said the 2008 team was warrior-like, marking hard in all sectors, with 'the others more technical'; Hernanes and Richarlyson as physical reference.

bas.personaBrief: Squad built with free signings and experienced players, nine stayed through three titles; he asked for a bigger squad and was cautious with academy players (JB 2008).

lid.personaBrief: Obedient, demanding daily cobrança (JB 2008) but also union and harmony in the group (Trivela 2008) and backing players like Aloisio; boss with same rules for all.
